_comment: Where the elevation agent's data lives. Paths are relative to this folder by default or can be absolute. Overridden by ELEVATION_AGENT_DATASET_ROOT and ELEVATION_AGENT_OUTPUT_ROOT.
_fixture_root_comment: Finished e2e runs the TESTS read their fixtures from. Can be overridden with ELEVATION_AGENT_FIXTURE_ROOT.
_run_dirs_comment: Run directories are output_root/<candidate>/llm-facade-subagent-<candidate> by default. creative-020 predates that convention and keeps its historical name.
